subject: CALL statement
notes: RE-VERDICTED by kb/Work PB971. `cite.py --check 14.9.4.4 "the EC-PROGRAM-ARG-OMITTED exception condition is set to exist"` -> OK §14.9.4.4 12). The prior CONFORMS held on the lenient half only: with checking ON no reference ever raised (the name was queried only around a CALL, so the callee's referencing statement never enabled the flag; a group or redefined formal's boundary copy was never checked at all). Now every rendered reference whose access path is rooted at a formal (elementary, subordinate, REDEFINES view, subscript/ref-mod position, GLOBAL formal from a contained program) renders through OmittedFormal under the element-kind ambient gate; the two exemptions (the omitted-argument condition; the whole formal forwarded as an argument, GR1c) do not render the path. Checking OFF stays lenient (pb133_omitted_lenient).
